text: You will be happiest if you keep from sinning and saying stupid things,
and if you have no reason to feel guilty and have not given up hope. *
What's the use of being rich if you don't enjoy spending money on yourself?
Are you just saving it so others can live in luxury after you are dead and gone?
Those who refuse to enjoy a few things money can buy, probably won't give much to someone in need.
They spend nothing, and punish themselves with the greatest misery. *
If they do a good deed, it is only by accident, and the end of their life shows how evil they were:
they pretended not to notice others in need;
they were never happy with their own fair share; and by taking what belonged to others, their souls shriveled away.
They wouldn't even give their families enough to eat!
Be good to yourself according to what you have and be generous in your giving to the Lord.
You cannot know the time for you to die, and when it arrives, death will not wait,
so now is the time to help your friends with generous gifts.
Every day, you should enjoy the good things you want,
because after you are gone, others will divide up everything you worked so hard to get.
Give and accept gifts, and treat yourself well, because there is nothing good in the world of the dead.
Every living creature wears out like old clothes and obeys the ancient law that says, “You will die.”
Generations pass away, and others are born to take their place, just as new leaves on a tall tree replace those that fall.
Everything you ever made will someday turn to dust, then even the memory of you will disappear.
Wisdom always blesses those who learn how to reason by thinking about her.
They consider what Wisdom has done and the secrets she knows.
They wait for her like hunters along a path, then they follow her
home, where they peek through the windows and listen at the door. *
They set up camp so close to her house, that their tent pegs are hammered into its walls.
There is no better place to live than in her home—
like a shade tree, she protects the children of her followers
from the heat, and they live in a place of great beauty.
